title: Rabbi Chama of Kefar Techumin
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:7: Rabbi Yudan son of Rabbi Chama of Kefar Techumin. In Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14: Rabbi Yehudah in the name of Rabbi Chama of Kefar Techumin. Hyman suggests that “bar” was written and became “in the name of Rabbi.”

notes.text: The consulted Yerushalmi gives Yudan son of Chama of Kefar Techamin. Shir HaShirim Rabbah gives Yehudah reporting Chama of Kefar Techumin. Hyman proposes a copying change to explain the different relationships.
